description:
At i360technologies, we specialize in business consulting and technology services for federal agencies. We are seeking an experienced R12 Oracle EBS RICE and PL/SQL Financials R12 Developers to support an existing R12 Federal Financials shared service environment. The candidates should have at least 7 years’ experience in Oracle R12 financial applications and processes implementation.

 Responsibilities:  

 
 Assist in supporting and implementing reports, interfaces, data conversions and enhancements in an R12 environment 

 Provide input, design, and review of overall strategy for conversion of legacy data onto shared service provider (SSP) Oracle E Business Suite applications system 

 Perform development using Structured Query Language (SQL) and Procedural Language/Structured Query Language (PL/SQL), R12 APIs and web services 

 Utilize R12 APIs to establish web services 

 Perform mapping, design, build, test, and deployment services in support of the data migration to the shared service provider (SSP) 

 Support the technical design of data conversion and extensions from legacy internal and external systems into the standardized software and processes of a shared service provider (SSP) using Oracle E Business Suite applications 

 Execute Unit testing and/or System Integration Testing (SIT) testing of development work and document results per approved test templates and procedures 

 Assist in development of test scripts and training materials 

 Create documentation (technical documents, data mapping, TE040, etc) for data conversions and application extensions 

 Provide triage support for data migration defects 

 Assist in preparing work tasks, task duration estimates, and schedules 

 Provide problem analysis/diagnosis/resolution, implementation, and post-implementation support 

 Provide knowledge transfer to support personnel and users as needed 

 Support of system and users after initial cut over to SSP 

 
 Requirements:  

 
 7+ years general software development experience with specialized experience in developing within the Oracle R12 applications, specifically data conversions and application extensions 

 Experience developing with TOAD, PL/SQL, SQL, load scripts, UNIX scripts, Personalization, Interfaces, Workflow, XML Publisher, R12 APIs and web service development 

 Demonstrated experience with the Oracle technology stack including: 

 
 PL/SQL development 

 Oracle Discoverer 

 Oracle JDeveloper 

 Oracle RDBMS 

 R12 APIs and Web services 

 Oracle Apex

 
 Must understand Oracle Applications table structure and APIs 

 Experience with configuration management tools and processes 

 Experience documenting design, code, testing 

 Experience unit testing, integration testing, and conducting code reviews 

 Oracle Financials Applications and specific experience with AP, AR, CLM, GL/ SLA and FedAdmin experience is a plus 

 Experience with shared service provider is a plus 

 Experience with project implementation life cycle 

 Experience developing within service-oriented architectures (SOA) using web services is a plus 

 
 Qualifications 

 
 Bachelor’s degree plus 7 years’ experience or equivalent related experience

 Demonstrated excellent customer service skills

 Strong communication, presentation, analytical, and technical skills

 Proficient in Microsoft Word, Power Point, and Excel

 Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision

 Must be able to clear a federal background investigation - Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information

 Must be a US Citizen or Green Card 

 
 Work week: Monday-Friday
Location: Gaithersburg, MD

 Salary 
Salary is commensurate with experience, ranging from $110,000 – $120,000 (Maximum)

 Security & Eligibility Requirements

 
 Ability to obtain and maintain a federal Public Trust (suitability) clearance

 Must be able to pass a federal background investigation

 U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residency required (no visa sponsorship available)

 
 Benefits

 
 Holidays - Eleven 

 Retirement Plan (401k) Matching

 Short-Term & Long-Term Disability

 Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)

 Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)

 Paid Time Off (0-3 years - 15 Days PTO | 3+ years 20 Days)

 
 Equal Opportunity Employer: 
 We are an equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

 Only direct applicants will be considered. Submissions from recruiting or staffing firms will not be accepted.
